WITH account_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    t.account_id, 
    d.A3 as region, 
    AVG(t.amount) as account_avg 
  FROM trans t 
  JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id 
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id 
  GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3
),
region_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    region, 
    AVG(account_avg) as region_avg
  FROM account_avgs
  GROUP BY region
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(region_avg) as overall_avg
  FROM region_avgs
),
kept_regions AS (
  SELECT 
    r.region, 
    r.region_avg, 
    r.region_avg - o.overall_avg as diff
  FROM region_avgs r
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
  WHERE r.region_avg > o.overall_avg
),
final_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(region_avg) as final_avg
  FROM kept_regions
)
SELECT 
  region, 
  region_avg,
  diff,
  region_avg / f.final_avg as ratio
FROM kept_regions
CROSS JOIN final_avg f
ORDER BY region
